name: Kent Agbayani
greeting: Hey! I'm Kent — I build and maintain ENVIS. Ask me about the dashboard, GIS, or this pixel office.

rules.reply: I design and maintain the ENVIS platform: data pipelines, authenticated API, the maps and the dashboards you see in the other tabs.
GIS is my main tool. I normalise coordinates, build spatial layers and make sure every facility lands on the right spot in the map.
You'll find me in the GIS / Development / IT office — top row, second door from the left.
This little office is a Phaser scene. Each walking sprite is one of us, and this chat is a scripted persona built from our real roles.

fallback: I can talk about ENVIS, GIS, maps, or where the team sits. Try one of the suggested questions.

name: Atty. Edward T. Ang
greeting: Good day. I am the Regional Director. Official institutional decisions and approvals rest with this office.

rules.reply: As Regional Director I hold final institutional authority for EMB Region VII decisions, directions and approvals.
Kent administers and maintains the ENVIS platform. Platform administration is technical — it does not replace institutional approval authority.
My office is the Office of the Regional Director — the first room on the top row.

fallback: I can clarify institutional authority, the Regional Director's role, or where the executive office is located.

name: Stepen Roie Lee
greeting: Hi, I'm Stepen. I lead MIS, Planning and PISMU — the information and coordination side of the office.

rules.reply: MIS manages the management information systems that keep regional reporting and dashboards running.
Planning and PISMU coordinate programmes, reporting and information across the region.
I'm in the MIS / Planning / PISMU office — top row, third door.

fallback: Ask me about MIS, planning, PISMU, or my office location.

name: Jumar Doublas
greeting: Hi! I handle web checking and lead IT tasks, and I'm an Environmental Specialist II.
prompts: What do you do in IT?

rules.reply: Web checking means reviewing published pages and dashboards for accuracy, broken links and data-quality issues before people rely on them.
I support lead IT work — keeping the tools, access and day-to-day technical operations running.
I share the GIS / Development / IT office with Kent — top row, second door.

fallback: I can explain web checking, IT support, or point you to our office.

name: Akira Lyod Fajardo
greeting: Hello! I encode ECC and CNC records and support GIS work for clearances.

rules.reply: ECC is an Environmental Compliance Certificate and CNC is a Certificate of Non-Coverage. I encode those clearance records and keep their GIS references tidy.
I maintain the clearance register so the ECC & CNC tab has reliable project, proponent and status information.
My desk is in the ECC & CNC Data Office — second row, first door.

fallback: Ask me about ECC and CNC encoding, clearance records, or where I sit.

name: Engr. Alfred Calumba
greeting: Good day. I manage the air and water permitting records — discharge permits and permits to operate.

rules.reply: A Discharge Permit (DP) authorises wastewater discharge. I manage those records and their expiry information.
A Permit to Operate (PTO) covers facilities and pollution-control equipment. I keep DP and PTO records aligned.
I work in Air & Water Permitting — second row, third door.

fallback: I can explain discharge permits, permits to operate, or where the permitting section sits.

name: Jason Tecson
greeting: Hi, I'm Jason. I manage hazardous waste registrations and records.

rules.reply: Hazardous waste registrations track generators, waste streams and compliance. I keep those records organised for the Hazardous Waste tab.
I maintain generator registrations, waste codes and the links to permits so the dashboards can show compliance status.
My office is Hazardous Waste Records — top row, last door on the right.

fallback: Ask me about hazardous-waste registrations, records, or my office.

name: Christine Alipuyo Gigante
greeting: Hello! I encode and maintain Solid Waste Management information for the region.

rules.reply: SWM covers Materials Recovery Facilities, landfills, dumpsites, WACS and compliance summaries. I keep that register up to date.
I maintain the SWM database that feeds the Solid Waste Management tab — facilities, LGU coverage and annual summaries.
I'm in the SWM Data & Encoding office — bottom row, second door from the left.

fallback: I can talk about SWM records, MRFs, WACS, or where my office is.

name: Kurt Baylan
greeting: Hi! I manage AQMS data — the air-quality monitoring readings you see in Ambient Corner.
prompts: Where does the data come from?

rules.reply: AQMS is the Air Quality Monitoring System. Ambient Corner shows hourly PM2.5 and PM10 from Talisay and Toledo plus manual AQI samples.
Readings come from the public AQMS Google Sheet. The Worker refreshes it every minute, and the historical dashboard is rebuilt from the same source.
I work in the AQMS Data & Monitoring office — bottom row, first door.

fallback: Ask me about AQMS, PM2.5/PM10, the live feed, or my office location.

name: EJ Dimacali
greeting: Hi, I'm EJ. I handle server operations and database security for EMB systems.

rules.reply: I look after server infrastructure and database security — accounts, sessions and keeping unpublished data behind the authenticated API.
Normal dashboard roles can view their own tabs. Sensitive views like this Pixel Office are restricted to MIS and RD, with a timed session.
I'm in the Server & Database Security room — second row, last door on the right.

fallback: I can explain server security, dashboard access rules, or where the server room is.
